error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot make this decision. Reviewers may uphold; owners, admins and instructors may also grant exceptions.
error.INVALID_INPUT: Write a note of at least {min} characters for the learner.
error.SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: This is your own request. Another staff member must decide it.
error.INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER_REQUIRED: This gate needs a reviewer who did not judge this learner's evidence.
error.GATE_REVIEW_ALREADY_DECIDED: This request was already decided. Refresh the queue.
error.GATE_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND: This request no longer exists. Refresh the queue.
error.GATE_CHANGED: The course changed this gate. The request cannot be decided under the new version.
error.GATE_ALREADY_READY: The learner now meets the gate; no exception is needed. Uphold the request instead.
error.GATE_CAP_REACHED: The course limit or deadline has been reached. An exception cannot lift it.
error.fallback: The decision could not be saved. Nothing changed.
